name: Surge
description: a kid who lives in the scrap yards. Gets bitten by an unknown species of spider. Gaining the ability to fuse metal to themselves and unleash electrical crunts.

metal_fusion.title: Metal Fusion
metal_fusion.description: Fuse metal to your body, increasing your defense and allowing you to block attacks.
commands: effect give @s minecraft:resistance 10 1 true
playsound minecraft:block.anvil.use player @s ~ ~ ~ 0.8 0.9
execute at @s run particle minecraft:block minecraft:iron_block ~ ~1 ~ 0.5 0.5 0.5 0.05 30

electric_shock.title: Electric Shock
electric_shock.description: Fire an electrokinesis-style bolt that shocks enemies and spreads static to nearby targets.

particle minecraft:electric_spark ~ ~1 ~ 3 3 3 0.5 100
playsound minecraft:entity.lightning_bolt.thunder player @s
